date_text: Thu, Jun 18th • 12:00 PM AEST - Sun, Jun 21st • 10:00 PM AEST
description: Always a pleasure to welcome Holgate back to the rooftop! We’ve been lucky enough to host Paul Holgate himself on many occasions over the years, and every time he brings something special. Expect a line-up featuring some much-loved classics alongside a few rare treats and specialty releases that showcase why Holgate remains one of the country’s most respected breweries. Join us on the rooftop for a celebration of great beer, great stories and great company. Taplist: - Millennium Falcon (9%) - Hop Fuzz ( 4.2% English pale/Golden Ale) - X Marks the Spot ( American-hopped XPA at 5.5%) - Wild Red Ale (Flander style wild sour, 6%) - Road Trip IPA (6%) - ESB (5%) - Temptress Choc Porter (6%) - Dry Irish Stout (5%) - Pilsner (5%) - Hefewiess (5%) - Wild Berry Sour (raspberry sour, 4.6%) - Australian XPA (5.2%)
